name: Tyrique Daniel
headline: TECHNICAL LEAD | FOUNDING ENGINEER
summary: Technical Lead and Founding Engineer with 8+ years of experience architecting, building, and scaling production software across startup and enterprise environments. Experienced in full-stack development, AI systems, distributed architecture, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, CI/CD, and engineering leadership. Proven ability to take products from early requirements through architecture, implementation, deployment, observability, and production operation. Strong hands-on background in TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, and Kubernetes, with experience leading distributed teams and collaborating across product, design, infrastructure, and business stakeholders.

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Led architecture and development for a production AI sales automation platform spanning web applications, AI services, workflow orchestration, data processing, and cloud infrastructure.
Designed an event-driven architecture with Apache Pulsar, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis/Valkey that supported 40% platform-workload growth without performance degradation.
Established production observability with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Tempo, reducing time to identify bottlenecks across distributed services.
Designed AI agent and workflow systems integrating LLMs, APIs, CRM platforms, and business rules for automated sales operations.
Built data-ingestion pipelines processing 140M+ property records, enabling enrichment, scoring, and personalization at scale.

experience.title: Founding Engineer
bullets: Owned full-stack architecture for a cross-platform communication product using React Native, Django, Java, Go, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
Optimized Django APIs and PostgreSQL data-access patterns for real-time workloads, reducing API response times by 50%.
Built CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, automating iOS and Android deployments and reducing manual deployment errors by 60%.
Led technical execution across a globally distributed development team, establishing development workflows, code-review practices, and delivery processes.

experience.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
bullets: Designed and delivered production AI applications across frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure layers.
Built distributed AI infrastructure with Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, Apache Ray, and Redis, reducing AI response time by 40%.
Designed PySpark and Pandas pipelines for multimillion-row datasets, reducing processing time by 50%.
Automated production infrastructure and deployment using GitHub Actions and Terraform, improving release consistency across environments.

experience.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
bullets: Designed large-scale full-stack applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Go.
Contributed to architecture reviews, technical planning, and cross-functional engineering decisions.
Built CI/CD and testing workflows that reduced deployment time by 40% and improved release consistency.

experience.title: Lead Full Stack Developer
bullets: Led development of full-stack applications using React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Apollo, and GraphQL, reducing page load times by 30%.
Designed backend services and API architecture, improving application performance by 25%.

experience.title: Front End Developer
bullets: Developed and maintained React, JavaScript, CSS, Bootstrap, and SCSS web applications, improving site performance and user experience.
Introduced lazy loading, memoization, and efficient state management, increasing site traffic by 20% while improving accessibility and cross-browser reliability.

experience.title: Web Developer
bullets: Developed and maintained client web applications using HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, translating requirements into improved functionality and a 20% increase in engagement.
Improved responsive and cross-platform delivery through front-end performance optimization, reducing page load times by 30% and improving accessibility.
